'''Arakelyan''' ({{langx|hy|Առաքելյան}}), also transliterated as '''Arakelian''', is an Armenian surname. Notable people with the surname include:

;Arakelyan
*[[Alik Arakelyan]] ({{langx|hy|Արայիկի Առաքելյան}}) (born 1996), Armenian footballer
*[[Ararat Arakelyan]] ({{langx|hy|Արարատ Առաքելյան}}) (born 1984), Armenian footballer
*[[Babken Arakelyan]] ({{langx|hy|Բաբկեն Առաքելյան}}) (1912–2004), Armenian historian
*[[Eduard Arakelyan]] ({{langx|hy|Էդուարդ Առաքելյան}}) (born 1950), Armenian painter
*[[Karine Arakelyan]] ({{langx|hy|Կարինե Առաքելյան}}) (born 1979), Armenian television presenter
*[[Tigran Arakelyan]], Armenian-American conductor

;Arakelian
*[[Artashes Arakelian]] ({{langx|hy|Արտաշես Առաքելյան}}) (1909–1993), Armenian economist
*[[Hambardzum Arakelian]] ({{langx|hy|Համբարձում Առաքելյան}}) (1865–1918), Armenian journalist, writer and activist
*[[Marat Arakelian]] ({{Langx|hy|Մարատ Արսեն Առաքելյան}}) (1929–1983), Armenian astrophysicist
*[[Narine Arakelian]] (born 1979), Armenian interdisciplinary feminist artist
*[[Norair Arakelian]] ({{Langx|hy|Սենեքերիմ Առաքելյան}}) (1936–2023), Armenian and Soviet mathematician
*[[Senekerim Arakelian]] ({{Langx|hy|Նորայր Հունանի Առաքելյան}}) (1902–2000), Armenian-American Holocaust survivor
